text: Everything on the bar, buddy, in a large. Long haul tonight. Delores does the hard part, but still.

text: Brown guacamole. I'm not eating anything older than my shoes.

text: Oh, no. Oh, buddy. No. I seen roadkill with better manners.

text: Sup. I skated here. It's downhill. Ice cream is the reward for downhill.

text: There's a fly in the sprinkles! He's buzzing! He's faster than me! Nobody's faster than me!

text: A donut with a coffee inside it. If you can't, a jelly one. I'll pretend the jelly is coffee.

text: Hi! Hello! Jitters! That's not my real name. It's my real name now.

text: This salmon smells off. I smelled it before it reached the counter.

text: Oh, and one of everything. It's a big job today. Mostly the eating part.
